text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
We wish you a spectacular,<n>magnificent—very
happy birthday! We<n>got you a present too!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I get to have birthday wishes AND<n>birthday
presents?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: I... I'm just so happy right now!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. We got you one of those carrot<n>scones they
just came out with. It's<n>very tasty.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Hehehe... We lined up early in the<n>morning to get it!
Treasure it for life!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: You bet! I do want to eat it, but I'll<n>treasure it for life!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Th-that was a joke! Please eat it!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...No need to panic, El—I doubt Spe<n>would be able to
resist anyway.
